name: wobbly-weathery-web-clock
description: A wobbly morphing clock in front of a physically based, real-time sky. Static files: this package.json only holds the tests and the linter.

scripts.test: node tools/schema-json.mjs && node tools/stamp.mjs && npm run lint && node tests/run.mjs changed
scripts.test:quick: node tools/schema-json.mjs && node tools/stamp.mjs && npm run lint && TIER=fast node tests/run.mjs all
scripts.test:full: node tools/schema-json.mjs && node tools/stamp.mjs && npm run lint && node tests/run.mjs all
